title: Hebrews, the general epistles and Revelation
note: After Paul's letters come Hebrews, whose author is unnamed, and the general letters of James, Peter, John and Jude, written to wide circles of believers. Revelation, traditionally attributed to John, closes the Bible with visions given on the island of Patmos, ending in a new heaven and a new earth.
